newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia, Indonesia in joint finance pact.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia, Indonesia in joint finance pact.

text.p: Australia and Indonesia on Monday signed an agreement aimed at boosting co-operation and information exchange between the two neighbours' finance industries.
Australian Treasurer Peter Costello and visiting Indonesian Finance Minister Mar'ie Mumammad signed the agreement in Canberra.
Mar'ie said in a statement he hoped the pact would "facilitate the exchange of ideas, materials, expertise and personnel in the areas of insurance companies, pension funds and accounting practices".
The two ministers also said the agreement would help boost training co-operation.
